rows.en: showed no sign of moving at all.
This was a sign that Haman
rows.note: Shared by zz06 (after S02308) and zz07 (after S02318); reads after both.

rows.en: meant to settle it all in a duel with Judau -
such was her will.
rows.note: Mapped 'ishi no araware' as a closing tag so the verb stays in row 1 of the sentence.

rows.en: Watched over by his comrades,
Judau sorties with firm resolve.
At Core 3, the birthplace of Zeon,
the curtain was about to rise on the final battle.
But Haman, the one left standing,
rows.note: zz07: follows Glemy's death and the collapse of his army.

rows.en: turned her forces toward the Nahel Argama
yet would not set them in motion.
Wearing a pilot suit for the first time,
Haman sorties.
For Zeon, the Battle of Jaburo
rows.note: Glossary term 'Battle of Jaburo' for the Jaburo capture operation; shared by 0a01 and 0b01.

rows.en: ended in failure.
Char's defeat by the Gundam played a large part,
but the exploits of Kamuna's unit on the ground
were undeniably remarkable, too.
In the wake of this battle,
rows.note: Shared by 0a01 and 0b01; neutral wording fits both.

rows.en: Zeon's ground forces
were driven into dire straits across the board,
and the main battlefield
gradually shifted to space.
Universal Century 0080, January 1,
after the fall of A Baoa Qu.
rows.note: JP is a fragment ending in a full stop; attached it to the date line as the same sentence.

rows.en: The Republic of Zeon and the Earth Federation Government
rows.note: Long vs JP width guide (~55 chars vs ~43); kept glossary names in full for the checker.

rows.en: signed an armistice.
Having lost their leaders, Gihren Zabi
rows.note: Shared 0a02/0b02 line 7; continues into S02337 (0a) or S02370 (0b).

rows.en: and Kycilia Zabi, the Zeon forces
were disbanded and absorbed into the Federation Forces,
and all fighting came to an end.
Peace had come to humanity.
People sensed it would be only fleeting,
yet for now, all they did was
rest their bodies and minds.
Universal Century 0083.
The Zeon remnant forces,
the Delaz Fleet, launched a war that ended
rows.note: Recast 'the war the Delaz Fleet started ended when...' as 'X launched a war that ended when...' to keep the row cuts.

rows.en: when, upon the North American breadbasket,
part of a colony came crashing down.
As a result,
just as the Delaz Fleet had planned,
Earth's food production suffered a severe blow.
But Jamitov Hymen and other
senior Earth Federation officials turned it to their advantage.
To mop up the Zeon remnant forces still at large,
rows.note: Shared 0a03/0d03; both preceded by Jamitov and senior officials, so 'they' in S02355 holds.

rows.en: they argued that an elite unit was needed,
and so the "Titans"
came to be formed.
And, in opposition to this,
the anti-Earth Federation group "AEUG" was formed.
Furthermore, at Axis, far from Earth,
military preparations were steadily under way.
A war among these three powers
for control of the Earth Sphere
was only a matter of time.
On the ground, the work of Kamuna's unit
truly deserved to be called heroic, but
Colonel Char's raid on headquarters
failed, and that proved the turning point;
in the end, the entire army collapsed.
and Kycilia Zabi,
rows.note: 0b02: continues S02336 'Having lost their leaders, Gihren Zabi'.

rows.en: the Zeon forces had been defeated, yet
rows.note: JP 'Zeon-gun de atta ga' has no predicate of its own; added 'had been defeated' (established by the armistice/fall of A Baoa Qu) to give English a verb.

rows.en: few of them meekly surrendered to the Federation.
Some joined the remnant forces in Africa,
some hid on the Moon, biding their time,
and others headed for the Asteroid Belt
and the asteroid Axis.
The embers left smoldering all over
held a hint that the peace humanity had found
was truly nothing but fleeting -
a foreshadowing of things to come.
rows.note: 'anji shite ita' moved to a closing appositive so the row keeps the verb's sense.

rows.en: The anti-Earth Federation group AEUG
launched an operation to seize Jaburo, the Titans' HQ,
but with the Titans
having moved to the "Gate of Zedan" at Side 7
as their new base,
it ended without any great results.
Foreseeing that the fighting in space would intensify again,
rows.note: 'Mikoshita' (foresaw) sits in next-slice row S02388 ('mikoshita AEUG wa'); pulled into this row for English order. S02388 should then read just 'the AEUG...'.

decisions: Narration in past tense; JP historical present (ukeru, toru, kessei sareru) rendered as past.
Kept JP corner-bracket quotes as ASCII double quotes around "Titans", "AEUG", "Gate of Zedan".
'Sorties' used for shutsugeki for both Judau (S02313) and Haman (S02320).
'Fleeting' used for tsuka no ma in both peace passages (S02341, S02379).
uncertain: S02371: added 'had been defeated' to supply a verb for the bare 'it was the Zeon forces, but'.
S02387: took 'Foreseeing' from S02388 into this row; next slice must not repeat it.
S02316: 'the one left standing' for nokotta Haman (after Glemy's fall); could be 'who remained'.
S02366: 'heroic' for katsuyaku to yobu ni atai suru (deserving to be called a real success); Kamuna's side in 0b01 appears to be Zeon.
S02334: line likely wider than the JP line; kept glossary names in full.
